quests.title: scrypted-mcp (Scrypted control via MCP)
quests.notes: hooptiej/scrypted-mcp — 10 tools shipped & tested live: list_devices, get_device_state, camera_snapshot, set_onoff, set_lock, get_recording_active, set_recording_active, get_device_mixins, add_device_mixin, record_clip, get_live_stream_url. Ongoing as new needs come up.

quests.title: Scrypted HomeKit pairing (post Mac-mini → TrueNAS move)
quests.notes: All 4 cameras paired and streaming. Fixed: Docker host networking, avahi mDNS conflict, stale advertiserAddresses setting, iOS cellular fallback, stale per-camera pairing residue.

quests.title: Scrypted NVR recording without paid licensing
quests.notes: Migration goal was partly to avoid the NVR license. HKSV pairing/streaming works, but motion never reaches Scrypted (broken ONVIF event subscriptions on these cameras) and every free workaround dead-ends into the license wall. Options: deploy Frigate alongside Scrypted, pay for the license, or revisit later.

quests.title: rtsp:// → VLC handler (Windows)
quests.notes: HKCU:\Software\Classes\rtsp registered to VLC directly. Pasting a plain rtsp:// URL into a browser address bar now prompts "Open VLC?" and launches it.

entries: Added scrypted MCP server (hooptiej/scrypted-mcp), deployed on TrueNAS.
Fixed a real scrypted-mcp bug: shared McpServer crashed on any second session.
Diagnosed and fixed HomeKit pairing across all 4 cameras (5 layered causes).
Restarted the Scrypted app container for Apple Home re-pairing.
Explored NVR recording licensing — confirmed blocked, 3 options identified.
Shipped 6 more scrypted-mcp tools, incl. real ffmpeg-based live clip capture.
Switched scrypted-mcp to Docker host networking for record_clip.
Fixed a second scrypted-mcp bug: stale client after a Scrypted restart.
Disabled GitHub Issues on all 6 public repos; unwatched 2 unrelated upstream repos.
Set up rtsp:// → VLC as a registered Windows protocol handler.
Built this quest log — first as a claude.ai artifact, then as its own self-hosted site.
